parameters.content:
## 3a. Flight tracking - REAL

**AeroDataBox**, host `aerodatabox.p.rapidapi.com`, `GET /flights/number/{number}/{date}`. Endpoint and field names taken from their published OpenAPI spec, not guessed.

`arrival.revisedTime` is the live ETA; it falls back through `predictedTime` then `scheduledTime`.

➡️ **Put your RapidAPI key in the header on that node.** Flight Status is a paid tier.

## 3b. Your live location - REAL

Point **OwnTracks** (HTTP mode) or an **iOS Shortcut** at the webhook. OwnTracks posts `{_type:'location', lat, lon, tst}`; a Shortcut can post `{lat, lon}`. Both shapes are handled.

**OSRM** then gives real driving minutes from where your phone is to the chalet coordinates saved with the trip. Free, keyless.

Swap in Google Distance Matrix if you want an SLA.

## Why these two are phone calls

Not a cop-out - a limitation of the market:

• **No consumer taxi API** in Japan.
• **No public consumer Uber Eats ordering API.** Uber's Eats APIs are merchant/POS side only, behind an NDA and partner approval.

So the system places a **real Bland.ai voice call** to the contact you saved in CONFIG. Voice is the only interface those businesses expose - calling them IS the automation.
